title: Satellite Pretraining Is Not One Thing: A Matched-Pair Study of Generic and Earth-Observation Foundation Models for Scene Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.13849v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Geospatial foundation models are pretrained on satellite and aerial imagery, but whether such an encoder beats a strong generic one for few-label land-use/land-cover mapping remains unclear, as prior comparisons rarely isolate the pretraining data. We study five matched pairs of Earth-observation (EO) and generic encoders sharing objective and architecture (DINO/SatDINO, DINOv3/DINOv3-SAT, MAE/SatMAE, MAE/Scale-MAE, CLIP/RemoteCLIP) within a benchmark of 14 frozen encoders on five RGB scene-classification datasets (0.06-30 m GSD). With native preprocessing, we evaluate k-NN, linear and attentive probes and image retrieval over six low-label splits, using paired per-image significance tests. translated_title: 卫星预训练并非一概而论：通用与对地观测基础模型在场景分类任务上的配对对比研究
translated_abstract: 地理空间基础模型是在卫星与航空影像上进行预训练的，但这类编码器在少标签土地利用/土地覆盖制图任务中是否优于强大的通用编码器，目前仍不清楚，因为以往的对比研究很少将预训练数据单独隔离出来加以考察。我们在一个包含14个冻结编码器的基准上，研究了五组共享训练目标与架构的对地观测（EO）与通用编码器配对组合（DINO/SatDINO、DINOv3/DINOv3-SAT、MAE/SatMAE、MAE/Scale-MAE、CLIP/RemoteCLIP），并覆盖五个RGB场景分类数据集（地面采样距离0.06–30米）。在采用原生预处理条件下，我们在六个低标签数据划分上评估了k-NN、线性探针、注意力探针以及图像检索，并使用逐图像配对的显著性检验。结果表明，对地观测预训练并非普遍有益：在大多数数据集和指标上，它显著提升了三组配对的表现（SatDINO、Scale-MAE、RemoteCLIP，其中后者仅在未见过的数据集上评估），却显著损害了两组配对的表现（线性探针下：DINOv3-SAT最多降低……[摘要此处被截断]）
tldr: 该研究通过五组共享目标与架构的编码器配对实验和显著性检验发现，对地观测预训练并不必然优于通用预训练：它显著提升了SatDINO、Scale-MAE、RemoteCLIP等模型的场景分类性能，却显著损害了DINOv3-SAT等另一部分模型的表现。
en_tdlr: Through five matched-pair comparisons of EO and generic encoders sharing the same objective and architecture, this study shows that Earth-observation pretraining is not uniformly beneficial: it significantly improves scene-classification performance for some encoders (SatDINO, Scale-MAE, RemoteCLIP) while significantly hurting others (e.g., DINOv3-SAT).
